api/src/models/orm/platform_jobs.py.name: Background job records
api/src/models/orm/platform_jobs.py.description: Holds each long background operation with its progress, result, errors and whether it can still be cancelled.

api/src/models/orm/policy_rule.py.name: Named access rules
api/src/models/orm/policy_rule.py.description: Holds reusable named rules that record and file policies can point to.

api/src/models/orm/product_updates.py.name: Release note receipts
api/src/models/orm/product_updates.py.description: Remembers which release notes each admin has already seen, so they are not shown twice.

api/src/models/orm/scheduler_diagnostics.name: Scheduled job health
api/src/models/orm/scheduler_diagnostics.description: Holds the health of the servers that run scheduled work and the outcome of each scheduled task.

api/src/models/orm/scheduler_leases.py.name: Scheduled job turns
api/src/models/orm/scheduler_leases.py.description: Decides which server currently holds the right to run scheduled work, so it never runs twice.

api/src/models/orm/services.py.name: Always-on services
api/src/models/orm/services.py.description: Holds each always-on service's settings, its supervised attempts and its recent log lines.

api/src/models/orm/solution_config_schem.name: Solution setting requests
api/src/models/orm/solution_config_schem.description: Records which settings a Solution needs so installing it can ask for them.

api/src/models/orm/solution_connection_s.name: Solution connection requests
api/src/models/orm/solution_connection_s.description: Records which outside service connections a Solution needs before it can install.

api/src/models/orm/solution_deploy_jobs..name: Solution install progress
api/src/models/orm/solution_deploy_jobs..description: Holds each in-progress Solution install with its steps and outcome so people can watch it.

api/src/models/orm/solution_export_jobs..name: Solution backup jobs
api/src/models/orm/solution_export_jobs..description: Holds each in-progress Solution backup with its progress and the file it produced.

api/src/models/orm/solution_file_locatio.name: Solution file places
api/src/models/orm/solution_file_locatio.description: Records where a Solution keeps its files so they can be found after installing.

api/src/models/orm/solution_workflow_per.name: Solution permission requests
api/src/models/orm/solution_workflow_per.description: Records which extra permissions a Solution's workflows ask for so an admin can approve them.

api/src/models/orm/solutions.py.name: Installed Solutions
api/src/models/orm/solutions.py.description: Holds each installed Solution with its version, source and current state.

api/src/models/orm/summary_backfill_job..name: Summary rebuild jobs
api/src/models/orm/summary_backfill_job..description: Holds each bulk job that re-creates run summaries, with its progress and estimated cost.

api/src/models/orm/tables.py.name: Custom tables and rows
api/src/models/orm/tables.py.description: Holds custom tables built in the platform and the rows people and workflows store in them.

api/src/models/orm/user_invites.py.name: Invitation links
api/src/models/orm/user_invites.py.description: Holds each single-use invitation link, who it was for and when it expires.

api/src/models/orm/users.py.name: People and roles
api/src/models/orm/users.py.description: Holds staff accounts, the roles they can be given and where each role applies.

api/src/models/orm/vector_type.py.name: Knowledge search fingerprints
api/src/models/orm/vector_type.py.description: Stores the numeric fingerprints documents are compared by when searching the knowledge library.

api/src/models/orm/work_dispatches.py.name: Waiting work items
api/src/models/orm/work_dispatches.py.description: Holds each unit of work waiting to be picked up, so nothing is lost if a server stops.

api/src/models/orm/worker_metric.py.name: Server health snapshots
api/src/models/orm/worker_metric.py.description: Records regular memory and processor readings from the servers doing the work, for the health screen.

api/src/models/orm/workflow_operation_us.name: Daily action counts
api/src/models/orm/workflow_operation_us.description: Counts how often each workflow used each built-in action, day by day.

api/src/models/orm/workflow_permissions..name: Workflow permission grants
api/src/models/orm/workflow_permissions..description: Records the extra capabilities a restricted workflow has been allowed to use.

api/src/models/orm/workflow_roles.py.name: Workflow role access
api/src/models/orm/workflow_roles.py.description: Links each workflow to the roles allowed to run it.

api/src/models/orm/workflow_run_daily.py.name: Run history totals
api/src/models/orm/workflow_run_daily.py.description: Holds daily counts of finished runs kept after the detail is cleared out, so reports stay accurate.

api/src/models/orm/workflows.py.name: Runnable code register
api/src/models/orm/workflows.py.description: Registers every runnable piece of code with its name, type, settings and owner.
